cohort: The study included digital pictures of 19 TAPS placentas (12 spontaneous TAPS, 7 post-laser TAPS) and 19 uncomplicated monochorionic placentas examined at the study's center.
finding: TAPS placentas exhibited a significantly higher color difference ratio (CDR) compared to uncomplicated monochorionic twin placentas, and large inter-twin Hb differences in TAPS were associated with higher CDR.
